 `./pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md`

```text
1	# `centos_server` profile on a noRoot CentOS 7 box installs nothing
2	
3	## Symptom
4	
5	Run `chezmoi apply` on a CentOS Linux 7.9 box where the user has no
6	`sudo` (typical corporate/data-center development server):
7	
8	```
9	$ sudo -v
10	sudo: PAM account management error: Permission denied
11	sudo: a password is required
12	```
13	
14	`chezmoi apply` completes cleanly, ansible reports `0 failed`, configs
15	deploy under `~/.config/`, but `command -v rg fd jq nvim starship`
16	returns nothing. The dotfiles-deployed `~/.zshrc` references binaries
17	that don't exist; opening a new shell prints `command not found` for
18	half the prompt.
19	
20	## Root cause
21	
22	The Linux ansible roles have two parallel install paths for each tool:
23	
24	1. **System-level** (`apt:` / `yum:`) — gated by `become: true, tags:
25	   [sudo]`. Skipped on `noRoot=true` via `--skip-tags sudo`. Correct.
26	2. **User-level fallback** — downloads pre-built binaries from GitHub
27	   releases into `~/.local/bin/`, no sudo required.
28	
29	The user-level fallback is the one that's *supposed* to fire on a
30	noRoot box. It was historically gated on
31	`when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"` — which made sense when
32	the only Linux profiles were `ubuntu_*`, but is wrong as soon as a
33	RedHat-family box (CentOS, Rocky, Alma) shows up. The user-level path
34	has no apt-specific behaviour — it's `curl | tar | install`. There's
35	no reason for it to be gated on the package-manager family.
36	
37	So on CentOS 7 with `noRoot=true`, both paths are gated out:
38	
39	- system-level: skipped by `--skip-tags sudo`
40	- user-level: skipped by `os_family == "Debian"` predicate
41	
42	The role is a no-op and the user gets a working `~/.zshrc` pointing at
43	binaries that were never installed.
44	
45	## Fix
46	
47	Broaden the user-level (non-sudo-tagged) `when:` predicates from:
48	
49	```yaml
50	when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
51	```
52	
53	to:
54	
55	```yaml
56	when: ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
57	```
58	
59	Applied across `dot_ansible/roles/{base,starship,security_tools,rust_cargo_tools}/tasks/main.yml`
60	when the `centos_server` profile was introduced. The
61	`Re-check if X is installed` + `Install X from GitHub releases
62	(user-level, no sudo)` block pattern is the canonical shape — every
63	file that has it needs the broadening.
64	
65	**Don't** broaden the sudo-tagged `apt:` blocks the same way — those
66	have `become: true, tags: [sudo]` and use `ansible.builtin.apt:` which
67	fails on RedHat. Either leave them alone (skipped under `--skip-tags
68	sudo` anyway) or add a parallel `RedHat` block with `ansible.builtin.yum:`.
69	
70	## CentOS 7-specific notes (glibc 2.17)
71	
72	CentOS 7 ships glibc 2.17 (released 2012). Many modern GitHub-release
73	binaries are built on Ubuntu 22.04 or 24.04 (glibc 2.35+) and crash
74	with:
75	
76	```
77	./tool: /lib64/libc.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.29' not found (required by ./tool)
78	```
79	
80	### CentOS 7 also ships Python 3.6.8 — bootstrap pins ansible to Python 3.13
81	
82	Symptom on a fresh CentOS 7 box:
83	
84	```
85	[INFO] Installing ansible via uv...
86	Resolved 10 packages in 4m 29s
87	Installed 10 packages …
88	 + ansible-core==2.11.12          ← suspicious: latest is 2.18+
89	…
90	[INFO] Installing ansible-galaxy collections...
91	[WARNING]: Skipping Galaxy server https://galaxy.ansible.com/api/. Got an
92	unexpected error when getting available versions of collection community.general:
93	'/api/v3/plugin/ansible/content/published/collections/index/community/general/versions/'
94	ERROR! Unexpected Exception, this is probably a bug:
95	'/api/v3/plugin/ansible/content/published/collections/index/community/general/versions/'
96	[ERROR] Failed to install community.general collection.
97	chezmoi: 00_bootstrap.sh: exit status 1
98	```
99	
100	Two compounding issues:
101	
102	1. **`uv tool install` defaults to system Python.** On CentOS 7 that's
103	   Python 3.6.8. uv resolves `ansible-core` to **2.11.12** — the last
104	   version with Py3.6 support, released August 2021.
105	2. **2.11.12 predates Galaxy NG.** `galaxy.ansible.com` was migrated to
106	   the Pulp/Galaxy-NG backend; ansible-core 2.11 hits the new
107	   `/api/v3/plugin/ansible/content/published/...` endpoint and throws
108	   `KeyError(<that URL string>)` because it expects the legacy v2
109	   shape. Output makes it look like a network/proxy error — it's not.
110	   The proxy hint in the bootstrap script's error message is a red
111	   herring on CentOS 7.
112	
113	**Fix (already in `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl`):** install
114	ansible with `uv tool install --force --python 3.13 ansible-core`. uv
115	auto-fetches a python-build-standalone interpreter (statically linked,
116	glibc-2.17 compatible) and pulls modern ansible-core (2.18+) that
117	speaks Galaxy NG. Same pattern as `pre-commit` in
118	`dot_ansible/roles/security_tools/tasks/main.yml`.
119	
120	The bootstrap also detects an existing ansible install on Python <3.10
121	and force-reinstalls — so a box that previously bootstrapped with the
122	old line auto-heals on the next `chezmoi apply`. If you want to nuke
123	manually: `uv tool uninstall ansible-core && rm -rf
124	~/.local/share/uv/tools/ansible-core`.
125	
126	
127	
128	The user-level fallbacks in `base/tasks/main.yml` already prefer
129	**musl** assets where upstream offers them — `ripgrep`, `fd`, `lnav`
130	all ship `*-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz` variants that are statically
131	linked and ignore glibc version. Those are fine on CentOS 7.
132	
133	Tools that ship glibc-only binaries (some Go releases, some Rust
134	releases without musl variants) will fail. Workarounds, in order of
135	preference:
136	
137	1. **Cargo source build** — `cargo install <crate>` works on CentOS 7
138	   via the user's mise/cargo toolchain (`rust_cargo_tools` role
139	   already sets this up).
140	2. **Older release pin** — find a release built before the upstream
141	   project moved to a newer Ubuntu CI, pin to it.
142	3. **Skip on CentOS 7** — for tools that aren't critical, gate the
143	   block on `ansible_distribution_major_version != "7"` and live
144	   without it.
145	
146	If the box gets rebuilt as Rocky/Alma 8 or 9 (glibc 2.28 / 2.34), most
147	of these go away — the gate-broadening fix above is still correct on
148	those.
149	
150	## Required preconditions on a noRoot CentOS box
151	
152	The dotfiles can't install **everything** without sudo. On
153	`centos_server` + `noRoot=true`, verify before running `chezmoi apply`:
154	
155	- `command -v zsh` resolves — `zsh` package install needs sudo. Most
156	  corporate CentOS 7 boxes ship zsh; if not, ask the admin to
157	  `yum install zsh`.
158	- `command -v git` resolves — same story.
159	- `chsh -s "$(command -v zsh)"` — depends on the box's chsh policy
160	  (usually no sudo needed but `/etc/shells` must list zsh's path).
161	
162	## Migration note
163	
164	If/when this CentOS 7 box gets rebuilt as Rocky/Alma 8 or 9 (or any
165	modern RedHat-family distro), the gate-broadening change in this fix
166	remains correct (`os_family == "RedHat"` still matches). The
167	glibc-2.17 caveat goes away. The `yum:` blocks added to `base`,
168	`zsh`, `ruby_gem_tools` continue to work — `yum:` is an alias for
169	`dnf:` on RHEL 8+ via the ansible compatibility shim.
170

281	# 4. Install ansible if missing (or refresh if running on stale Python <3.10)
282	#
283	# `uv tool install` defaults to the system Python. On CentOS 7 / RHEL 7 the
284	# system is Python 3.6.8 — uv would resolve `ansible-core` to 2.11.12 (last
285	# version supporting Py3.6, August 2021) which predates Galaxy NG and crashes
286	# on `ansible-galaxy collection install community.general` with a KeyError on
287	# the `/api/v3/plugin/ansible/content/...` URL. Pin to Python 3.13 so uv
288	# auto-fetches a python-build-standalone interpreter (statically linked,
289	# glibc-2.17 compatible) and pulls a modern ansible-core (2.18+) that speaks
290	# Galaxy NG. Mirrors the `uv tool install --python 3.13 pre-commit` pattern
291	# in dot_ansible/roles/security_tools/tasks/main.yml.
292	NEED_ANSIBLE_INSTALL=0
293	if ! command -v ansible-playbook &> /dev/null; then
294	    NEED_ANSIBLE_INSTALL=1
295	elif ansible-playbook --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'python version = 3\.(6|7|8|9)\.'; then
296	    info "Detected ansible on stale Python (<3.10); will reinstall on Python 3.13"
297	    NEED_ANSIBLE_INSTALL=1
298	fi
299	if [[ "$NEED_ANSIBLE_INSTALL" == "1" ]]; then
300	    info "Installing ansible via uv (Python 3.13)..."
301	    uv tool install --force --python 3.13 ansible-core
302	    success "ansible installed successfully"
303	else
304	    info "ansible is already installed"
305	fi

307	# 5. Install ansible-galaxy collections
308	info "Installing ansible-galaxy collections..."
309	if ansible-galaxy collection install community.general --force-with-deps; then
310	    success "ansible-galaxy collections installed"
311	else
312	    # Check if collection is already installed (e.g. network blocked by GFW)
313	    if ansible-galaxy collection list community.general 2>/dev/null | grep -q community.general; then
314	        warn "Galaxy download failed but community.general is already installed, continuing..."
315	    else
316	        error "Failed to install community.general collection. Ansible playbooks will not work."
317	        error "Try setting: export https_proxy=http://your-proxy:port"
318	        exit 1
319	    fi
320	fi
321	
322	# 6. Install mise global tools (Node.js) if mise config exists
323	MISE_BIN="${HOME}/.local/bin/mise"
324	[[ ! -x "$MISE_BIN" ]] && MISE_BIN="$(command -v mise 2>/dev/null || true)"
325	if [[ -x "$MISE_BIN" ]] && [[ -f "$HOME/.config/mise/config.toml" ]]; then
326	    info "Installing mise global tools..."
327	    if "$MISE_BIN" install --yes; then
328	        success "mise tools installed"
329	    else
330	        warn "mise install had errors (some tools may have failed to build). Continuing..."
331	    fi
332	fi
333	
334	# 7. Ensure ~/.local/bin is on PATH for bash sessions (idempotent)
335	# chezmoi, uv, mise all live in ~/.local/bin. Dotfiles only wire this up in
336	# zsh; until the user switches shells, bash needs help finding them.
337	BASHRC="$HOME/.bashrc"
338	LOCAL_BIN_LINE='export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"'
339	if [[ -f "$BASHRC" ]] || [[ "${SHELL##*/}" == "bash" ]]; then
340	    touch "$BASHRC"
341	    if ! grep -qF "$LOCAL_BIN_LINE" "$BASHRC"; then
342	        {
343	            echo ""
344	            echo "# Added by chezmoi bootstrap - ~/.local/bin for uv, mise, chezmoi"
345	            echo "$LOCAL_BIN_LINE"
346	        } >> "$BASHRC"
347	        info "Added ~/.local/bin to PATH in $BASHRC"
348	    fi
349	fi

## Findings Report: Docker/CentOS Setup Compatibility Analysis

### 1. **Smoke Tests Assertions** (tests/smoke/docker_install.bats:1-80)

The smoke test file contains **7 assertions**, all of which are platform-agnostic (no Ubuntu-specific checks):
- Line 14-22: `chezmoi apply` idempotence (diff empty) — works on all OSes
- Line 24-29: zsh shell syntax validation — no OS-specific paths
- Line 31-43: zsh module parsing — no OS-specific paths  
- Line 45-49: neovim headless execution — no OS-specific assertions
- Line 51-54: nvim config directory check — no OS-specific paths
- Line 56-64: core CLI tool presence (`nvim`, `rg`, `fd`, `fzf`, `zsh`, `just`, `bats`) — these are binary names, platform-agnostic
- Line 66-71: oh-my-zsh plugin directories — no OS-specific paths
- Line 73-79: unit test re-run — no OS-specific assertions

**Finding:** All smoke tests will pass on CentOS 7 / Rocky / Alma without modification. No conditional skips needed.

---

### 2. **centos_server Profile Dispatch** (run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl:134-142)

```bash
{{ else if eq .profile "centos_server" -}}
PLAYBOOK="$ANSIBLE_DIR/playbooks/linux.yml"
# CentOS Server: same playbook + tag set as Ubuntu Server. Ansible roles
# disambiguate apt vs yum via ansible_os_family ("Debian" vs "RedHat").
# On a noRoot CentOS box every [sudo]-tagged task is skipped; what
# actually runs are the user-level GitHub-release / cargo / mise
# fallbacks — see pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md for the gate-broadening
# fix that lets those fire on RedHat too.
TAGS="base,zsh,starship,neovim,lazyvim_deps,devtools,docker,security_tools,rust_cargo_tools,ruby_gem_tools"
```

**Key dispatch logic:**
- Uses same `linux.yml` playbook as ubuntu_server (line 135)
- Same tag set as ubuntu_server, excluding gui_apps (line 142)
- On `noRoot`, ansible role dispatch via `--skip-tags sudo` (line 272, visible in broader context) 
- RedHat-family detection via `ansible_os_family == "RedHat"` (roles use this)
- noRoot interaction: roles check both `when: ansible_os_family in ["RedHat"]` AND `tags: [sudo]` — if noRoot, `--skip-tags sudo` disables system yum but falls back to GitHub-release binaries

---

### 3. **Bootstrap Assumptions Breaking in CentOS 7 Docker**

**apt-only assumptions in run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl:**

Line 170-172: Linuxbrew deps (apt-get only)
```bash
if command -v apt-get &> /dev/null; then
    sudo_run apt-get update
    sudo_run apt-get install -y build-essential procps curl file git
```

Line 212-216: Ruby/ansible dev dependencies (apt-only)
```bash
if command -v apt-get &> /dev/null; then
    sudo_run apt-get install -y libffi-dev libyaml-dev python3-dev 2>/dev/null || true
```

**Issue:** Both are guarded by `command -v apt-get` but have **no yum/dnf fallback**. On CentOS 7 without `apt`, these silently skip, leaving build dependencies uninstalled. Ruby compilation (mise ruby) will then fail unless pre-installed.

**Base role apt-only assumptions (dot_ansible/roles/base/tasks/main.yml:38-46):**

Line 38-46: fd symlink creation (Debian-specific)
```yaml
- name: Create fd symlink on Debian/Ubuntu
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  become: true
  tags: [sudo]
  ansible.builtin.file:
    src: /usr/bin/fdfind
    dest: /usr/bin/fd
```

**Issue:** CentOS ships `fd` directly, not under `fdfind`. This is not executed (correct), but the comment assumes Debian naming.

**Systemd dependencies (containers without systemd):**

docker/tasks/main.yml:90-106 (Debian systemd user services):
```yaml
- name: Disable and stop rootful docker system units (Debian/Ubuntu)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  become: true
  tags: [sudo]
  ansible.builtin.systemd_service:  # ← requires systemd
```

rust_cargo_tools/tasks/main.yml:154-160 (pueued systemd user service):
```yaml
- name: Enable and start pueued service
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
  ansible.builtin.systemd:  # ← requires systemd
    scope: user
    enabled: true
    state: started
    daemon_reload: true
  ignore_errors: true  # May fail in containers without systemd  ← COMMENT ACKNOWLEDGES THIS
```

**Breaking assertion:** docker role will execute `ansible.builtin.systemd_service` on RedHat (when it has docker tag + not noRoot). In a non-systemd Docker container (typical: `FROM centos:7`), this fails unless `ignore_errors: true` is added. Docker role is **Debian-only** in implementation (lines 33-148), so this only breaks if we extend it to RedHat.

---

### 4. **CentOS 7 EOL / vault.centos.org Handling**

**Finding:** No `vault.centos.org` redirect handling found in repo.
```bash
grep -r "vault.centos.org" /Users/zhouhanru/.local/share/chezmoi → (no results)
```

CentOS 7 base repos moved to vault.centos.org on June 30, 2024. Default `/etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-Base.repo` now points to vault. **This is NOT handled in the repo.** If building a centos:7 Docker image, the base image itself should already have vault URLs pre-configured, but a manual Dockerfile build might need:
```dockerfile
RUN sed -i 's/^mirrorlist=/#mirrorlist=/g; s/^#baseurl=http:\/\/mirror.centos.org/baseurl=http:\/\/vault.centos.org/g' /etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-*.repo
```

---

### 5. **Ansible Roles: RedHat/Debian Split Summary**

**Roles with RedHat support:**
- **base** (lines 48-68): yum for system packages + GitHub-release user-level fallbacks (ripgrep, fd, jq, git-lfs, just) ✓
- **ruby_gem_tools** (lines 21-30): yum for libffi-devel, libyaml-devel ✓
- **rust_cargo_tools** (lines 68-160): Both Debian & RedHat pueue + systemd (systemd: ignore_errors=true on line 160) ✓
- **security_tools** (lines 42-210): Gitleaks binary download (platform-agnostic; system vs user-level split for Debian only, lines 57-125 Debian, lines 135-210 user-level for both) ✓
- **starship** (lines 21-76): Official installer + user-level fallback for both Debian & RedHat (lines 29-76) ✓
- **zsh** (lines 12-27): yum for zsh package ✓

**Roles Debian-only (will skip on RedHat or error):**
- **bitwarden** (snap/deb based)
- **coding_agents** (apt assumptions)
- **devtools** (apt for 100+ CLI tools, no RedHat branch)
- **docker** (systemd_service module only for Debian lines 86-148; no RedHat yum/dnf rootless setup)
- **gui_apps_linux** (snap/deb/flatpak desktop apps)
- **iac_tools** (apt for Terraform/OpenTofu)
- **input_method** (fcitx/IBus apt packages)
- **js_cli_tools** (node, pnpm, bun)
- **lazyvim_deps** (only Debian lines 17-34; RedHat skipped entirely — **critical gap**)
- **llm_tools** (apt for Ollama, LiteLLM)
- **media_tools** (apt for ffmpeg, ImageMagick)
- **neovim** (apt + snap fallback, no RedHat)
- **nerdfonts** (apt-centric)
- **networking_tools** (apt for mtr, nmap, httpie)

**Platform-agnostic (install via Homebrew, mise, cargo, npm, curl binary):**
- **dotnet_tools** (cargo/npm/curl)
- **homebrew** (Darwin only)
- **python_uv_tools** (uv tool install)

---

## Summary

**What breaks for CentOS in Docker without changes:**
1. **lazyvim_deps role skips entirely** — no Debian/RedHat branching; node+treesitter fail to install
2. **devtools role skips entirely** — no yum branch; 40+ CLI tools missing
3. **Docker role skips** — systemd_service only on Debian; rootless Docker setup fails
4. **Bootstrap libffi/libyaml install skips** — no yum fallback (but ruby via mise may still succeed if pre-deps exist)
5. **13 more roles are Debian-only** (bitwarden, coding_agents, iac_tools, etc.) — but not in centos_server tag list, so OK
6. **No CentOS 7 vault.centos.org handling** — base image must pre-configure or Dockerfile needs sed line
```

43	        fi && \
44	        printf '%s\n' \
45	            "Types: deb" \
46	            "URIs: ${MIRROR_URL}" \
47	            "Suites: noble noble-updates noble-backports" \
48	            "Components: main restricted universe multiverse" \
49	            "Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg" \
50	            "" \

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
2	# Smoke tests intended to run inside the Docker `test` service container
3	# (see docker-compose.yml). They assert the post-`chezmoi apply` + post-ansible
4	# state of a fresh Ubuntu box.
5	#
6	# Do NOT run these on a host machine — they assume the chezmoi source lives at
7	# /tmp/dotfiles-source (matches Dockerfile COPY target) and that the container
8	# has just completed a full install.
9	
10	load "../test_helper.bash"
11	
12	SOURCE_DIR="${CHEZMOI_SOURCE_DIR:-/tmp/dotfiles-source}"
13	
14	@test "chezmoi apply is idempotent (diff is empty after re-apply)" {
15	  # Re-apply should be a no-op. A non-empty diff means templates drift or
16	  # run_once state tracking is broken.
17	  run chezmoi apply
18	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
19	  run chezmoi diff
20	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
21	  [ -z "$output" ]
22	}
23	
24	@test "zsh -n parses ~/.zshrc and ~/.zshenv without errors" {
25	  [ -f "$HOME/.zshrc" ]
26	  [ -f "$HOME/.zshenv" ]
27	  zsh -n "$HOME/.zshrc"
28	  zsh -n "$HOME/.zshenv"
29	}
30	
31	@test "~/.config/zsh exists and every *.zsh file parses cleanly" {
32	  [ -d "$HOME/.config/zsh" ]
33	  # Parse every deployed zsh module. A regression here means a syntax error
34	  # slipped through into the interactive shell path.
35	  local file failures=0
36	  while IFS= read -r file; do
37	    if ! zsh -n "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
38	      echo "zsh -n failed: $file" >&2
39	      failures=$((failures + 1))
40	    fi
41	  done < <(find "$HOME/.config/zsh" -type f -name '*.zsh')
42	  [ "$failures" -eq 0 ]
43	}
44	
45	@test "neovim is installed and can run a headless lua call" {
46	  command -v nvim
47	  run nvim --headless "+lua print('ok')" +qa
48	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
49	}
50	
51	@test "~/.config/nvim exists and init file is present" {
52	  [ -d "$HOME/.config/nvim" ]
53	  [ -f "$HOME/.config/nvim/init.lua" ] || [ -f "$HOME/.config/nvim/init.vim" ]
54	}

47	# Override locale to a safe default so ansible can start even before locale
48	# packages are installed (e.g. en_US.UTF-8 not yet generated on a fresh machine).
49	export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8

52	# --- Shared sudo session (see scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh for full docs)
53	# Inlined at template-render time so this script carries the helper body.
54	# bootstrap has already prompted + spawned a watchdog in the normal flow;
55	# the idempotent `sudo_session_init` below just re-exports the env vars
56	# and (re)registers the INT/TERM/HUP abort trap. It will prompt here only
57	# when the user ran ansible manually without the bootstrap phase.
58	{{ include "scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh" }}

61	# Whether ANY sudo surface is exercised in this run. Linux ansible always
62	# needs sudo unless noRoot. On macOS only the input_method role needs sudo.
63	NEED_SUDO={{ if or (and (eq .chezmoi.os "linux") (not .noRoot)) (and (eq .chezmoi.os "darwin") .installInputMethod) }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}

70	    eval "$(/usr/local/bin/brew shellenv)"
71	fi
72	{{ else -}}
73	# Linuxbrew
74	if [[ -d /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew ]]; then
75	    eval "$(/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
76	elif [[ -d "$HOME/.linuxbrew" ]]; then

78	fi

83	# (community.general.homebrew, mise, rustup, gem) inherit them. Without
84	# this, ghcr.io bottle downloads frequently fail with

99	info() { echo -e "\033[0;34m[INFO]\033[0m $1"; }
100	success() { echo -e "\033[0;32m[SUCCESS]\033[0m $1"; }

103	ANSIBLE_DIR="$HOME/.ansible"
104	export ANSIBLE_CONFIG="$ANSIBLE_DIR/ansible.cfg"
105	INVENTORY="$ANSIBLE_DIR/inventories/localhost.ini"
106	
107	command -v ansible-playbook &> /dev/null || { warn "ansible-playbook not found"; exit 0; }
108	
109	# === Profile-based tag selection ===
110	# Profile: {{ .profile }}
111	#
112	# Tag categories:
113	#   Core:    base, zsh, starship, neovim, lazyvim_deps, security_tools
114	#   Desktop: devtools, docker, nerdfonts
115	#   Server:  devtools, docker (no nerdfonts - no GUI)
116	#   macOS:   homebrew
117	#   Optional: coding_agents, bitwarden, python_uv_tools, llm_tools, rust_cargo_tools, ruby_gem_tools
118	
119	{{ if eq .chezmoi.os "darwin" -}}
120	PLAYBOOK="$ANSIBLE_DIR/playbooks/macos.yml"
121	# macOS: full desktop experience
122	TAGS="homebrew,base,zsh,starship,neovim,lazyvim_deps,devtools,docker,nerdfonts,security_tools,rust_cargo_tools,ruby_gem_tools"
123	{{ else if eq .profile "ubuntu_desktop" -}}
124	PLAYBOOK="$ANSIBLE_DIR/playbooks/linux.yml"
125	# Ubuntu Desktop: full desktop experience (no homebrew).
126	# gui_apps bundles alacritty + AppImageLauncher + VSCode + Cursor (see
127	# dot_ansible/roles/gui_apps_linux/tasks/main.yml); libfuse2 comes with it
128	# so AppImage-based editors work out of the box on Ubuntu 22.04+.
129	TAGS="base,zsh,starship,neovim,lazyvim_deps,devtools,docker,nerdfonts,security_tools,rust_cargo_tools,ruby_gem_tools,gui_apps"
130	{{ else if eq .profile "ubuntu_server" -}}
131	PLAYBOOK="$ANSIBLE_DIR/playbooks/linux.yml"
132	# Ubuntu Server: no GUI stuff (no nerdfonts)
133	TAGS="base,zsh,starship,neovim,lazyvim_deps,devtools,docker,security_tools,rust_cargo_tools,ruby_gem_tools"
134	{{ else if eq .profile "centos_server" -}}
135	PLAYBOOK="$ANSIBLE_DIR/playbooks/linux.yml"
136	# CentOS Server: same playbook + tag set as Ubuntu Server. Ansible roles
137	# disambiguate apt vs yum via ansible_os_family ("Debian" vs "RedHat").
138	# On a noRoot CentOS box every [sudo]-tagged task is skipped; what
139	# actually runs are the user-level GitHub-release / cargo / mise
140	# fallbacks — see pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md for the gate-broadening
141	# fix that lets those fire on RedHat too.
142	TAGS="base,zsh,starship,neovim,lazyvim_deps,devtools,docker,security_tools,rust_cargo_tools,ruby_gem_tools"
143	{{ else -}}
144	warn "Unknown profile: {{ .profile }}"
145	exit 0
146	{{ end -}}
147	
148	# Add optional tags based on chezmoi config
149	{{ if .installCodingAgents -}}
150	TAGS="${TAGS},coding_agents"
151	{{ end -}}
152	{{ $installBitwarden := false }}{{ if hasKey . "installBitwarden" }}{{ $installBitwarden = .installBitwarden }}{{ end -}}
153	{{ if $installBitwarden -}}
154	TAGS="${TAGS},bitwarden"
155	{{ end -}}
156	{{ if .installPythonUvTools -}}
157	TAGS="${TAGS},python_uv_tools"
158	{{ end -}}
159	{{ $installJsCliTools := false }}{{ if hasKey . "installJsCliTools" }}{{ $installJsCliTools = .installJsCliTools }}{{ end -}}
160	{{ if $installJsCliTools -}}
161	TAGS="${TAGS},js_cli_tools"
162	{{ end -}}
163	{{ $installLlmTools := false }}{{ if hasKey . "installLlmTools" }}{{ $installLlmTools = .installLlmTools }}{{ end -}}
164	{{ if $installLlmTools -}}
165	TAGS="${TAGS},llm_tools"
166	{{ end -}}
167	{{ $installInputMethod := false }}{{ if hasKey . "installInputMethod" }}{{ $installInputMethod = .installInputMethod }}{{ end -}}
168	{{ if $installInputMethod -}}
169	TAGS="${TAGS},input_method"
170	{{ end -}}
171	{{ $installNetworkingTools := false }}{{ if hasKey . "installNetworkingTools" }}{{ $installNetworkingTools = .installNetworkingTools }}{{ end -}}
172	{{ if $installNetworkingTools -}}
173	TAGS="${TAGS},networking_tools"
174	{{ end -}}
175	{{ $installIacTools := false }}{{ if hasKey . "installIacTools" }}{{ $installIacTools = .installIacTools }}{{ end -}}
176	{{ if $installIacTools -}}

184	{{ if $installDotnetTools -}}

191	# Install Bitwarden Desktop app (for SSH agent) on desktop profiles

203	{{ $discordChannel := "flatpak" }}{{ if hasKey . "discordChannel" }}{{ $discordChannel = .discordChannel }}{{ end -}}
204	if [[ -z "$EXTRA_VARS" ]]; then

213	# === Handle sudo (delegated to scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh) ==================
214	# The helper (sudo_session_init) is idempotent: if bootstrap already prompted
215	# the user and spawned the watchdog, this call just re-exports the env vars.
216	# If ansible is run standalone (bypassing bootstrap), it prompts here instead.
217	#
218	# After init we classify via sudo_session_skip_reason:
219	#   "cached"           -> pass $CHEZMOI_ANSIBLE_BECOME_FILE to ansible via -e @
220	#   "passwordless"     -> no become password needed
221	#   "non-interactive"  -> caller-specific fallback (below)
222	# Importantly we DO NOT run `sudo -k` here anymore — doing so would throw away
223	# the bootstrap-era cache and force a second prompt for the ansible phase.
224	BECOME_FLAGS=""
225	{{ if eq .chezmoi.os "darwin" -}}
226	{{ $noRoot := false }}{{ if hasKey . "noRoot" }}{{ $noRoot = .noRoot }}{{ end -}}
227	{{ if $noRoot -}}
228	info "noRoot mode enabled on macOS - skipping input_method (requires sudo for pkg installers)"
229	TAGS="${TAGS//,input_method/}"
230	{{ else -}}
231	# input_method role uses Homebrew cask pkg installers (Squirrel) which invoke
232	# `sudo /usr/sbin/installer` internally. Pre-warm the sudo timestamp via the
233	# shared helper so the non-TTY child process finds a live ticket.
234	if [[ "$NEED_SUDO" == "1" ]]; then
235	    if sudo_session_init "ansible"; then
236	        case "$(sudo_session_skip_reason)" in
237	            cached)
238	                # Refresh the current TTY's sudo timestamp so the cask child
239	                # `sudo /usr/sbin/installer` finds a live ticket (it does not
240	                # accept a piped password). The watchdog keeps it warm every 50s.
241	                sudo_session_warm_cache || warn "sudo_session_warm_cache failed; pkg casks may still prompt"
242	                ;;
243	            passwordless)
244	                info "Passwordless sudo detected"
245	                ;;
246	            non-interactive | "")
247	                warn "Non-interactive mode without passwordless sudo - pkg-based casks may be skipped"
248	                ;;
249	        esac
250	    else
251	        warn "Sudo session could not be established - pkg-based casks may be skipped"
252	    fi
253	fi
254	{{ end -}}
255	{{ else -}}
256	{{ $noRoot := false }}{{ if hasKey . "noRoot" }}{{ $noRoot = .noRoot }}{{ end -}}
257	{{ if $noRoot -}}
258	# noRoot mode: skip all sudo-requiring tasks, user-level fallbacks will install tools
259	info "noRoot mode enabled - installing user-level tools to ~/.local/bin"
260	info ""
261	info "The following tools will be installed without sudo:"
262	info "  neovim, fzf, lazygit, gh, diffnav, ripgrep, fd, jq, just, bat, eza, delta,"
263	info "  yazi, zellij, btop, gitleaks, zoxide, tldr, pre-commit, thefuck,"
264	info "  duckdb, rclone, litellm, llmfit, models"
265	info ""
266	info "The following tools require sudo (ask your administrator):"
267	info "  git, curl, wget, zsh, tmux, htop, direnv, build-essential, docker, ollama"
268	info ""
269	info "Suggested command for your administrator:"
270	info "  sudo apt install git curl wget zsh tmux htop direnv build-essential tree"
271	info ""
272	BECOME_FLAGS="--skip-tags sudo"
273	# Ruby can't compile without libffi-dev (requires sudo on Ubuntu)
274	TAGS="${TAGS//,ruby_gem_tools/}"
275	# gui_apps_linux: --skip-tags sudo already skips system apt/deb installers;
276	# this extra-var flips the user-level AppImageLauncher Lite path on so noRoot
277	# users still get AppImage desktop integration.
278	if [[ "$TAGS" == *gui_apps* ]]; then
279	    if [[ -z "$EXTRA_VARS" ]]; then
280	        EXTRA_VARS="gui_apps_linux_no_root=true"
281	    else
282	        EXTRA_VARS="$EXTRA_VARS gui_apps_linux_no_root=true"
283	    fi
284	fi
285	{{ if $installLlmTools -}}
286	if [[ -z "$EXTRA_VARS" ]]; then
287	    EXTRA_VARS="llm_tools_no_root=true"
288	else
289	    EXTRA_VARS="$EXTRA_VARS llm_tools_no_root=true"
290	fi
291	{{ end -}}
292	{{ else -}}
293	# Non-noRoot Linux: the shared helper gives us one of three outcomes.
294	if ! sudo_session_init "ansible"; then
295	    warn "Non-interactive mode without passwordless sudo and no /dev/tty access"
296	    warn "Skipping ansible run. To complete setup, run manually:"
297	    warn ""
298	    warn "  cd ~/.ansible && ansible-playbook -i inventories/localhost.ini \\"
299	    warn "    $PLAYBOOK \\"
300	    warn "    --tags '$TAGS' --ask-become-pass"
301	    warn ""
302	    warn "Or grant passwordless sudo:"
303	    warn "  echo '$USER ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/$USER"
304	    exit 0
305	fi
306	case "$(sudo_session_skip_reason)" in
307	    cached)
308	        info "Sudo session active (password cached; ansible becomes via -e @ans-become.yml)"
309	        BECOME_FLAGS="-e @$CHEZMOI_ANSIBLE_BECOME_FILE"
310	        ;;
311	    passwordless)
312	        info "Passwordless sudo detected"
313	        BECOME_FLAGS=""
314	        ;;
315	    non-interactive | "")
316	        # Shouldn't hit this after a successful sudo_session_init, but keep
317	        # the manual-command fallback in case probes contradict each other.
318	        warn "Sudo state inconsistent after session init; falling back to manual instructions"
319	        warn "  cd ~/.ansible && ansible-playbook -i inventories/localhost.ini \\"
320	        warn "    $PLAYBOOK \\"
321	        warn "    --tags '$TAGS' --ask-become-pass"
322	        exit 0
323	        ;;
324	esac
325	{{ end -}}
326	{{ end -}}
327	
328	info "Profile: {{ .profile }}"
329	info "Re-running ansible with tags: $TAGS"
330	EXTRA_VARS_ARGS=()
331	[[ -n "$EXTRA_VARS" ]] && EXTRA_VARS_ARGS=(--extra-vars "$EXTRA_VARS")
332	
333	{{ $allowPartialFailure := false }}{{ if hasKey . "allowPartialFailure" }}{{ $allowPartialFailure = .allowPartialFailure }}{{ end -}}
334	{{ if $allowPartialFailure -}}
335	# Best-effort mode: run each tag separately so one failure doesn't block others
336	info "allowPartialFailure=true: running each tag independently"
337	FAILED_TAGS=()
338	IFS=',' read -ra TAG_ARRAY <<< "$TAGS"
339	for tag in "${TAG_ARRAY[@]}"; do
340	    info "────── Running tag: $tag ──────"
341	    ansible-playbook -i "$INVENTORY" "$PLAYBOOK" --tags "$tag" $BECOME_FLAGS "${EXTRA_VARS_ARGS[@]}" || {
342	        warn "Tag '$tag' had failures (continuing in best-effort mode)"
343	        FAILED_TAGS+=("$tag")
344	    }
345	done
346	if [[ ${#FAILED_TAGS[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
347	    warn "────── Summary ──────"
348	    warn "The following tags had failures: ${FAILED_TAGS[*]}"
349	    warn "Retry manually:"
350	    warn "  cd ~/.ansible && ansible-playbook -i inventories/localhost.ini $PLAYBOOK --tags '$(IFS=,; echo "${FAILED_TAGS[*]}")' $BECOME_FLAGS ${EXTRA_VARS_ARGS[*]}"
351	    success "Ansible roles partially updated (${#FAILED_TAGS[@]} tag(s) failed)."
352	else
353	    success "Ansible roles updated!"
354	fi
355	{{ else -}}
356	ansible-playbook -i "$INVENTORY" "$PLAYBOOK" --tags "$TAGS" $BECOME_FLAGS "${EXTRA_VARS_ARGS[@]}"
357	success "Ansible roles updated!"
358	{{ end -}}

4	# pre-commit is installed via `uv tool install --python 3.13` on BOTH macOS and
5	# Linux so the Python bootstrap is identical across machines. This avoids the

7	# virtualenv creation for hook repos (symptom:
8	# `Symbol not found: _XML_SetAllocTrackerActivationThreshold`). See
9	# `docs/tools/pre-commit.md` for the full rationale.

25	      Re-run `chezmoi apply` so `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl`
26	      can install uv, or install it manually from https://astral.sh/uv.
27	
28	- name: Install pre-commit via uv (pinned Python 3.13, all OSes)
29	  ansible.builtin.command: uv tool install --force pre-commit --python 3.13
30	  register: precommit_install
31	  changed_when: "'already installed' not in (precommit_install.stdout | default('') ~ precommit_install.stderr | default(''))"

400	# sources: plain / interactive prompt / Bitwarden CLI / none.

414

418	
419	# Quick `chezmoi diff` against ONE host (serial, debug-friendly output).
420	# Use this in vibe loops to see exactly what your latest commit will do
421	# on a specific machine before pushing/applying for real.
422	fleet-diff HOST *ARGS:
423	    ./scripts/fleet_apply.py --dry-run --hosts {{HOST}} --serial {{ARGS}}
424	
425	# Apply ONLY a single chezmoi target on each host (skips ansible / Brewfile).
426	# PATH is the chezmoi target path, e.g. `.config/zsh/aliases.zsh` or
427	# `.zshrc`. Fast feedback for editing one dotfile across the fleet without
428	# waiting for full Linuxbrew/ansible cycles. Pass extra `--hosts HOST` to
429	# scope. Internally sets CHEZMOI_FLEET_APPLY_PATH so the wrapper runs
430	# `chezmoi apply <relpath>` instead of `chezmoi update --init`.

434	# Apply a feature BRANCH instead of pulling main. Each remote does
435	# `git fetch origin BRANCH && git checkout -B BRANCH origin/BRANCH &&
436	# git merge --ff-only origin/BRANCH` before chezmoi apply. Fails loud
437	# on divergence — use `just fleet-apply-branch-force` to nuke local
438	# state with `git reset --hard`. Local hosts skip this entirely (source
439	# is your editor's working tree).
440	fleet-apply-branch BRANCH *ARGS:

442	
443	# Like fleet-apply-branch but uses `git reset --hard origin/BRANCH` on
444	# remotes, destroying any local divergence. Use after force-pushing a
445	# rebased topic branch so every host follows.

456	
457	# Probe each host for running chezmoi/ansible (use after killing local SSH)

459	    ./scripts/fleet_apply.py --status {{ARGS}}
460	
461	# Like fleet-apply-status but re-poll every Ns until everyone is idle
462	# (Ctrl+C to stop). Default interval 10s; override with --watch=N in ARGS.
463	fleet-apply-watch *ARGS:

466	# Live-tail the remote fleet-apply log of HOST (defaults to most recent run);

475	fleet-apply-compact *ARGS:

1	#!/bin/bash
2	# Bootstrap script - installs Homebrew, uv, ansible, mise, and galaxy collections
3	# Runs BEFORE any ansible playbooks
4	# Profile: {{ .profile }}
5	
6	set -e
7	
8	# Colors for output
9	RED='\033[0;31m'
10	GREEN='\033[0;32m'
11	YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
12	BLUE='\033[0;34m'
13	NC='\033[0m' # No Color
14	
15	info() {
16	    echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"
17	}
18	
19	success() {
20	    echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1"
21	}
22	
23	warn() {
24	    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
25	}
26	
27	error() {
28	    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
29	}
30	
31	# Fix broken locale (e.g. RPi with LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 but locale not generated)
32	# Ansible requires UTF-8 encoding, so fall back to C.UTF-8 (not plain C).
33	if locale 2>&1 | grep -qi "cannot set"; then
34	    warn "Broken locale detected, falling back to LC_ALL=C.UTF-8"
35	    export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
36	    export LANG=C.UTF-8
37	fi
38	
39	# Ensure PATH includes local bin and Homebrew
40	export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
41	
42	# --- Shared sudo session (prompt once, reuse across bootstrap + ansible + brew)
43	# Inlined from scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh via chezmoi's `include` so the helper
44	# travels with the rendered script (no runtime path lookup back to the source
45	# tree). See that file for API, lifetime, and clean-up guarantees.
46	{{ include "scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh" }}
47	# --- end sudo helper
48	
49	# Decide at render time whether *any* script in the apply flow will need sudo.
50	# If not, we never prompt, never create the state dir, never spawn a watchdog.
51	# Conditions mirror the sudo surfaces in every run-script:
52	#   - Linux, non-noRoot: bootstrap apt-get + ansible become tasks.
53	#   - macOS, installBrewApps: pkg-based cask installers (google-drive, etc.).
54	#   - macOS, installInputMethod: Squirrel cask pkg installer (ansible).
55	NEED_SUDO={{ if or (and (eq .chezmoi.os "linux") (not .noRoot)) (and (eq .chezmoi.os "darwin") (or .installBrewApps .installInputMethod)) }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}
56	
57	# Set up the shared sudo session FIRST so bootstrap's own `apt-get` lines (and
58	# every later run-script) reuse the same cached credential. Trap INT/TERM/HUP
59	# only — no EXIT trap, because the next run-script needs the state to survive
60	# this process exiting. End-of-flow cleanup is done by the detached watchdog
61	# (see sudo_shared.sh).
62	if [[ "$NEED_SUDO" == "1" ]]; then
63	    if ! sudo_session_init "bootstrap"; then
64	        warn "Could not establish a sudo session (no TTY and sudo needs a password);"
65	        warn "bootstrap will attempt its sudo steps anyway and they may prompt or skip."
66	    fi
67	fi

69	{{ if .useChineseMirror -}}

71	# `brew install`, `rustup`, or `mise install` so every bootstrap fetch
72	# goes through the mirror instead of the blocked upstream.
73	# Homebrew mirrors (ordered by typical reliability behind GFW):

80	#   - TUNA:  Tsinghua, upstream of BFSU; frequent "Waiting in queue" on brew.git

- Line 66-71: oh-my-zsh plugin directories — no OS-specific paths
- Line 73-79: unit test re-run — no OS-specific assertions

**Finding:** All smoke tests will pass on CentOS 7 / Rocky / Alma without modification. No conditional skips needed.

### 2. **centos_server Profile Dispatch** (run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl:134-142)

```bash
{{ else if eq .profile "centos_server" -}}
PLAYBOOK="$ANSIBLE_DIR/playbooks/linux.yml"
# CentOS Server: same playbook + tag set as Ubuntu Server. Ansible roles
# disambiguate apt vs yum via ansible_os_family ("Debian" vs "RedHat").
# On a noRoot CentOS box every [sudo]-tagged task is skipped; what
# actually runs are the user-level GitHub-release / cargo / mise
# fallbacks — see pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md for the gate-broadening
# fix that lets those fire on RedHat too.
TAGS="base,zsh,starship,neovim,lazyvim_deps,devtools,docker,security_tools,rust_cargo_tools,ruby_gem_tools"
```

**Key dispatch logic:**
- Uses same `linux.yml` playbook as ubuntu_server (line 135)
- Same tag set as ubuntu_server, excluding gui_apps (line 142)
- On `noRoot`, ansible role dispatch via `--skip-tags sudo` (line 272, visible in broader context) 
- RedHat-family detection via `ansible_os_family == "RedHat"` (roles use this)
- noRoot interaction: roles check both `when: ansible_os_family in ["RedHat"]` AND `tags: [sudo]` — if noRoot, `--skip-tags sudo` disables system yum but falls back to GitHub-release binaries

---

### 3. **Bootstrap Assumptions Breaking in CentOS 7 Docker**

**apt-only assumptions in run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl:**

Line 170-172: Linuxbrew deps (apt-get only)
```bash
if command -v apt-get &> /dev/null; then
    sudo_run apt-get update
    sudo_run apt-get install -y build-essential procps curl file git
```

Line 212-216: Ruby/ansible dev dependencies (apt-only)
```bash
if command -v apt-get &> /dev/null; then
    sudo_run apt-get install -y libffi-dev libyaml-dev python3-dev 2>/dev/null || true
```

**Issue:** Both are guarded by `command -v apt-get` but have **no yum/dnf fallback**. On CentOS 7 without `apt`, these silently skip, leaving build dependencies uninstalled. Ruby compilation (mise ruby) will then fail unless pre-installed.

**Base role apt-only assumptions (dot_ansible/roles/base/tasks/main.yml:38-46):**

Line 38-46: fd symlink creation (Debian-specific)
```yaml
- name: Create fd symlink on Debian/Ubuntu
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  become: true
  tags: [sudo]
  ansible.builtin.file:
    src: /usr/bin/fdfind
    dest: /usr/bin/fd
```

**Issue:** CentOS ships `fd` directly, not under `fdfind`. This is not executed (correct), but the comment assumes Debian naming.

**Systemd dependencies (containers without systemd):**

docker/tasks/main.yml:90-106 (Debian systemd user services):
```yaml
- name: Disable and stop rootful docker system units (Debian/Ubuntu)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  become: true
  tags: [sudo]
  ansible.builtin.systemd_service:  # ← requires systemd
```

rust_cargo_tools/tasks/main.yml:154-160 (pueued systemd user service):
```yaml
- name: Enable and start pueued service
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
  ansible.builtin.systemd:  # ← requires systemd
    scope: user
    enabled: true
    state: started
    daemon_reload: true
  ignore_errors: true  # May fail in containers without systemd  ← COMMENT ACKNOWLEDGES THIS
```

**Breaking assertion:** docker role will execute `ansible.builtin.systemd_service` on RedHat (when it has docker tag + not noRoot). In a non-systemd Docker container (typical: `FROM centos:7`), this fails unless `ignore_errors: true` is added. Docker role is **Debian-only** in implementation (lines 33-148), so this only breaks if we extend it to RedHat.

---

### 4. **CentOS 7 EOL / vault.centos.org Handling**

**Finding:** No `vault.centos.org` redirect handling found in repo.
```bash
grep -r "vault.centos.org" /Users/zhouhanru/.local/share/chezmoi → (no results)
```

CentOS 7 base repos moved to vault.centos.org on June 30, 2024. Default `/etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-Base.repo` now points to vault. **This is NOT handled in the repo.** If building a centos:7 Docker image, the base image itself should already have vault URLs pre-configured, but a manual Dockerfile build might need:
```dockerfile
RUN sed -i 's/^mirrorlist=/#mirrorlist=/g; s/^#baseurl=http:\/\/mirror.centos.org/baseurl=http:\/\/vault.centos.org/g' /etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-*.repo
```

---

### 5. **Ansible Roles: RedHat/Debian Split Summary**

**Roles with RedHat support:**
- **base** (lines 48-68): yum for system packages + GitHub-release user-level fallbacks (ripgrep, fd, jq, git-lfs, just) ✓
- **ruby_gem_tools** (lines 21-30): yum for libffi-devel, libyaml-devel ✓
- **rust_cargo_tools** (lines 68-160): Both Debian & RedHat pueue + systemd (systemd: ignore_errors=true on line 160) ✓
- **security_tools** (lines 42-210): Gitleaks binary download (platform-agnostic; system vs user-level split for Debian only, lines 57-125 Debian, lines 135-210 user-level for both) ✓
- **starship** (lines 21-76): Official installer + user-level fallback for both Debian & RedHat (lines 29-76) ✓
- **zsh** (lines 12-27): yum for zsh package ✓

**Roles Debian-only (will skip on RedHat or error):**

**Which modern RedHat-family base image should the second Dockerfile use?**

Options:
- **rockylinux:9** - Most popular community RHEL rebuild; closest match to a typical 'modern CentOS-style server'. (Recommended)
- **almalinux:9** - Sister rebuild of Rocky; behaviorally near-identical to rockylinux:9 for our purposes.
- **quay.io/centos/centos:stream9** - CentOS Stream 9 — upstream of RHEL 9. Slightly more bleeding-edge package set.

**Should each CentOS image come in two flavors (noRoot=true and noRoot=false), or just one?**

Options:
- **Both flavors per image (4 services total)** - centos7 + centos7-noroot + rocky9 + rocky9-noroot. Covers your real-world noRoot use case AND surfaces gaps in Debian-only ansible roles when run with sudo. (Recommended)
- **noRoot=true only (2 services)** - Matches your actual corporate target. Smaller matrix, fewer expected failures; won't expose missing yum branches in devtools/lazyvim_deps/docker roles.
- **noRoot=false only (2 services)** - Wider coverage of system-level installs. Will fail loudly on Debian-only roles unless allowPartialFailure=true is set.

**Should the `test` smoke-test service be extended to run against the CentOS images too?**

Options:
- **Add test-centos7 and test-rocky9 services** - New compose services running bats smoke suite per image. Updates `just docker-test` and `check-all`. (Recommended)
- **Manual only (interactive shell, no bats)** - Just `just docker-run-centos7` style recipes; skip automated smoke tests for now.


**Answer:** rockylinux:9, Both flavors per image (4 services total), Add test-centos7 and test-rocky9 services
</details></tool-use>

# Plan: Docker test images for `centos_server` profile

## Context

The `centos_server` chezmoi profile already exists (`.chezmoi.toml.tmpl:20`,
profile choices include `centos_server`) and has a dedicated dispatch branch in
`.chezmoiscripts/global/run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl:134-142`. It
was added for a real corporate target (`yzhang-idc-server104` — CentOS Linux 7.9,
glibc 2.17, noRoot user). `pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md` documents the gate-
broadening fix that lets user-level GitHub-release fallbacks (`base`, `starship`,
`security_tools`, `rust_cargo_tools`) fire on RedHat-family boxes.

What we're missing is **install-test infrastructure** for this profile. The
existing `Dockerfile` / `docker-compose.yml` / `just docker-*` recipes are
Ubuntu-only (`FROM ubuntu:24.04`), so changes that affect the RedHat path can
only be validated by SSHing to the actual corporate box — slow, fragile, and
not reproducible.

This plan adds two RedHat-family Docker images (CentOS 7 + Rocky 9) each in
two flavors (noRoot=false and noRoot=true), wired into compose, the bats
smoke suite, and `just docker-*` recipes — same shape as the existing Ubuntu
matrix.

## Goals & non-goals

**Goals**
- Reproducible local install-test for `centos_server` profile: `just docker-test-centos7` / `just docker-test-rocky9`.
- Cover both the user's actual scenario (CentOS 7 + noRoot=true) and the modern path (Rocky 9 + sudo).
- Surface gaps in Debian-only ansible roles (`devtools`, `lazyvim_deps`, `docker`, `neovim`, `iac_tools`, etc.) so they show up as test failures we can tackle separately.

**Non-goals**
- Fixing the Debian-only roles. Those are a separate body of work; let them fail visibly under the new tests, then track via TODO.md / backlog/. (Roles already known to have RedHat support: `base`, `zsh`, `starship`, `ruby_gem_tools`, `rust_cargo_tools`, `security_tools`.)
- Running systemd inside containers. CentOS 7 / Rocky 9 base images don't have systemd; roles that use `ansible.builtin.systemd*` (`docker`, `rust_cargo_tools` pueued) already `ignore_errors: true` or are Debian-gated.
- Adding a `china` mirror variant for CentOS images. Out of scope for v1; CentOS 7 mirror story is moot post-EOL (vault is the only working source) and Rocky 9 already works against default mirrors from inside GFW.

## Files to add / modify

### New files

1. **`Dockerfile.centos7`** — `FROM centos:7`. Critical: rewrite `/etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-*.repo` to point at `vault.centos.org` BEFORE first `yum install` (CentOS 7 EOL'd 2024-06-30 and `mirrorlist.centos.org` returns 404). Then `yum install -y curl sudo git python3` (note: CentOS 7 ships Python 3.6.8 as `python3` — bootstrap's `uv tool install --python 3.13 ansible-core` already handles this, see `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl:299-302`). Mirror the rest of `Dockerfile` exactly (devuser + sudoers + COPY + chezmoi init with the same 17 `--prompt*` flags). Default `CHEZMOI_PROFILE=centos_server`.

2. **`Dockerfile.rocky9`** — `FROM rockylinux:9`. No vault redirect needed. Replace apt sections with `dnf install -y curl sudo git python3 --allowerasing` (curl-minimal conflict on Rocky 9). Default `CHEZMOI_PROFILE=centos_server`.

### Modified files

3. **`docker-compose.yml`** — add 5 services:
   - `centos7` — `Dockerfile.centos7`, `CHEZMOI_NO_ROOT=false`, `CHEZMOI_ALLOW_PARTIAL_FAILURE=true` (so Debian-only role failures don't abort).
   - `centos7-noroot` — `Dockerfile.centos7`, `CHEZMOI_NO_ROOT=true`. Closest match to the real corporate box. Profile gate: `centos`.
   - `rocky9` — `Dockerfile.rocky9`, `CHEZMOI_NO_ROOT=false`, `CHEZMOI_ALLOW_PARTIAL_FAILURE=true`. Profile gate: `rocky`.
   - `rocky9-noroot` — `Dockerfile.rocky9`, `CHEZMOI_NO_ROOT=true`. Profile gate: `rocky`.
   - `test-centos7` and `test-rocky9` — mirror the existing `test` service; run `bats /tmp/dotfiles-source/tests/smoke`. Profile gate: `test`. Per the Phase-1 finding, all 8 tests in `tests/smoke/docker_install.bats` are platform-agnostic, no test changes needed.

   Use `compose --profile <name>` gates exactly like the existing `desktop` / `china` / `test` services so default `docker compose up` still only builds the Ubuntu devbox.

4. **`justfile`** (extend the existing `# Docker` section, lines 8-49):
   - `docker-build-centos7` / `docker-build-rocky9` — build per service.
   - `docker-build-centos-all` — build all four CentOS-family services.
   - `docker-run-centos7` / `docker-run-centos7-noroot` / `docker-run-rocky9` / `docker-run-rocky9-noroot` — interactive shells.
   - `docker-test-centos7` / `docker-test-rocky9` — `docker compose --profile test run --build --rm test-centos7` (etc).
   - Extend `docker-build-all` to also build the four new services.
   - Extend `docker-clean` to `docker image rm dotfiles:centos7 dotfiles:centos7-noroot dotfiles:rocky9 dotfiles:rocky9-noroot 2>/dev/null || true`.
   - Extend `check-all` (line 266) to optionally include centos test runs (gate behind a flag — or leave as separate `just check-all-centos` to keep the default `check-all` runtime bounded).

5. **`README.md`** — under the existing Docker testing section (search for `just docker-test`), add a one-liner pointing at the new `just docker-test-centos7` / `just docker-test-rocky9` recipes and what they cover (CentOS 7 noRoot path = closest to corporate use case; Rocky 9 = modern RHEL-family). Keep it short — full details belong in `docs/this_repo/`.

6. **`docs/this_repo/architecture.md`** (or new `docs/this_repo/docker-testing.md` — verify which is the existing home of Docker docs first) — explain the matrix, why we have CentOS 7 vault redirect, why noRoot+sudo per image, and which roles are expected to fail on RedHat-family until their yum/dnf branches are added. Add nav entry to `mkdocs.yml` if a new file is created.

7. **`mkdocs.yml`** — only if (6) creates a new doc file. Add under "This Repo" section.

8. **`pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md`** — append a "How to repro locally" section pointing at `just docker-test-centos7` and `just docker-run-centos7-noroot`. Useful because anyone re-debugging the gate-broadening invariant can now boot a representative env in 60 seconds.

## Critical Dockerfile.centos7 details

CentOS 7 EOL on 2024-06-30 means the default repos in `centos:7` Docker image return 404. Required at the very top of the `RUN` chain, BEFORE any `yum install`:

\```dockerfile
RUN sed -i 's|^mirrorlist=|#mirrorlist=|g' /etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-*.repo \
 && sed -i 's|^#baseurl=http://mirror.centos.org|baseurl=http://vault.centos.org|g' /etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-*.repo
\```

Without this, the very first `yum install -y ca-certificates curl` fails with a DNS / 404 error and the whole layer collapses. The user's actual box may still be on a corporate mirror that hasn't redirected to vault — that's their admin's problem, but the Docker test must use vault.

`useChineseMirror=true` for CentOS 7 is intentionally **not** plumbed in this v1 — `vault.centos.org` is reachable from inside GFW; mirroring vault is a niche need.

## Why both noRoot=true and noRoot=false per image

| Service | What it tests |
|---|---|
| `centos7-noroot` | The actual corporate use case. User-level GitHub-release fallbacks in `base`, `starship`, `security_tools`, `rust_cargo_tools`. This is what `pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md` is about. Should mostly succeed. |
| `centos7` (sudo) | yum branches in `base`, `zsh`, `ruby_gem_tools`. Plus surfaces missing yum branches in Debian-only roles (`devtools` / `lazyvim_deps` / `docker` / `neovim` / `iac_tools`). `allowPartialFailure=true` keeps the run going. |
| `rocky9-noroot` | Same user-level path on glibc 2.34 — verifies fallbacks aren't accidentally pinned to glibc-2.17 musl variants when modern glibc is available. |
| `rocky9` (sudo) | Modern dnf path. Confirms gate-broadening from `os_family == "Debian"` to `in ["Debian", "RedHat"]` works on dnf-native distros, not just yum-on-CentOS-7. |

## Verification

After implementation, end-to-end test:

\```bash
# Build and run the noRoot CentOS 7 path (the real corporate scenario)
just docker-test-centos7
# Expected: bats reports 8/8 passing inside the centos7-noroot image

# Modern RHEL path
just docker-test-rocky9
# Expected: bats reports 8/8 passing inside rocky9-noroot

# Interactive smoke check (sudo path, expect partial failures from Debian-only roles)
just docker-run-centos7
# Inside container:
#   chezmoi diff       # should be empty (idempotence)
#   command -v rg fd jq nvim starship zsh just bats   # all should resolve
#   ansible-playbook --version  # python version = 3.13.x

# Cleanup
just docker-clean
# Expected: all four new images removed alongside existing dotfiles:* images
\```

Smoke-test pass criteria match the existing Ubuntu `test` service — bats TAP output, exit 0. If any of the 8 tests fail on RedHat-family, that's a bug to fix (likely in a Debian-only role missing a RedHat branch); track via `pitfalls/` or `TODO.md` per the project-knowledge-harness rules in `CLAUDE.md`.

## Reused patterns / utilities

- **Dockerfile shape**: copy verbatim from `Dockerfile` lines 7-29 (ARG block) and lines 96-145 (devuser + chezmoi init flag list). Only the OS-prep section (lines 30-94) changes.
- **compose service shape**: copy from `docker-compose.yml` lines 11-29 (`devbox`) for the regular services, lines 73-93 (`test`) for the test variants.
- **justfile recipe shape**: copy from `justfile` lines 13-49 — same one-liner pattern.
- **Dockerfile prompt-flag list**: must stay in sync with `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` and `scripts/init/dotfiles_init.py` per `CLAUDE.md` "Dockerfile + dotfiles_init wrapper" invariant. The new Dockerfiles inherit the existing 17-flag block unchanged — no new prompts introduced, so `dotfiles_init.py doctor` parity is automatic.
- **`scripts/redact_secrets.py` DEFAULT_PATHS**: not affected; new files don't introduce a new agent-artifact prefix.

## Risk / out-of-scope notes

- **Debian-only roles will fail loudly under sudo path.** That's the point — better to surface than to hide. `allowPartialFailure=true` on the sudo services keeps runs going so we get a complete failure list. The list of roles needing yum/dnf branches (per Phase-1 explore): `devtools`, `lazyvim_deps`, `docker`, `neovim`, `nerdfonts`, `networking_tools`, `iac_tools`, `media_tools`, `llm_tools`, `js_cli_tools`, `bitwarden`, `coding_agents`, `gui_apps_linux`, `input_method`. Triage which ones are in scope for `centos_server` (it's a server profile, so `gui_apps_linux` / `input_method` / `nerdfonts` don't matter; `devtools` and `lazyvim_deps` definitely do).
- **Docker layer cache**: rebuilding all four images from scratch downloads two new base images (~250 MB total) and re-runs ansible from zero. First `docker-build-centos-all` will be slow (~10-15 min); subsequent runs hit cache.
- **Bootstrap apt-get fallbacks**: `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl:170-175,212-216` install Linuxbrew deps + libffi/libyaml via apt-get, guarded by `command -v apt-get`. On CentOS, these silently skip — fine for Rocky 9 (Ruby/mise compile from `glibc-devel` shipped by base image), potentially a problem on CentOS 7 if mise tries to compile Ruby. If it bites, the fix is a sibling `command -v yum` branch in bootstrap; track separately if it surfaces.

```rocky9
# Dotfiles test/devbox container — Rocky Linux 9 (modern RHEL-family)
# Build: docker build -f Dockerfile.rocky9 -t dotfiles:rocky9 .
# Run:   docker run -it dotfiles:rocky9
#
# Tests the centos_server profile on a current dnf-native distro.
# Sister image to Dockerfile.centos7 (which targets the legacy glibc-2.17
# corporate scenario). Keep this file's ARG block + devuser + chezmoi
# init flag list in lockstep with Dockerfile and Dockerfile.centos7.

FROM rockylinux:9

# Build arguments for chezmoi configuration
ARG CHEZMOI_PROFILE=centos_server
ARG CHEZMOI_EMAIL=docker@example.com
ARG CHEZMOI_NAME="Docker User"
ARG CHEZMOI_USE_CHINESE_MIRROR=false
ARG CHEZMOI_GITLEAKS_ALL_REPOS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_CODING_AGENTS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_BITWARDEN=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_PYTHON_UV_TOOLS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_LLM_TOOLS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_AI_DESKTOP_APPS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_BREW_APPS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_INPUT_METHOD=false
ARG CHEZMOI_DISCORD_CHANNEL=none
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_NETWORKING_TOOLS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_IAC_TOOLS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_MEDIA_TOOLS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_NO_ROOT=false
ARG CHEZMOI_BACKUP_MODE=off
ARG CHEZMOI_ALLOW_PARTIAL_FAILURE=true
ARG CHEZMOI_MOTD_STYLE=figlet
ARG CHEZMOI_REPO=daviddwlee84

# Install minimal dependencies.
# --allowerasing resolves the curl-minimal vs curl conflict that ships in
# the rockylinux:9 base layer; without it dnf aborts on package conflict.
# python3 is required for ansible to run modules on localhost.
RUN dnf install -y --allowerasing \
        ca-certificates \
        curl \
        sudo \
        git \
        python3 \
    && dnf clean all

# Create non-root user with sudo access
RUN useradd -m -s /bin/bash devuser \
    && echo "devuser ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" >> /etc/sudoers.d/devuser \
    && chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/devuser

# Copy local dotfiles source into image
# This allows testing local changes without pushing to GitHub
COPY --chown=devuser:devuser . /tmp/dotfiles-source

# Switch to non-root user
USER devuser
WORKDIR /home/devuser

# Install chezmoi binary
# Retry up to 3 times to handle network issues
RUN for i in 1 2 3; do \
        echo "Attempt $i: Installing chezmoi to ~/.local/bin..." && \
        sh -c "$(curl -fsLS --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 get.chezmoi.io/lb)" && \
        echo "chezmoi installed successfully" && break || \
        { echo "Attempt $i failed, retrying..."; sleep 10; }; \
    done

# Initialize and apply dotfiles with prompt values passed via flags.
# Keep this flag list IDENTICAL to Dockerfile and Dockerfile.centos7 — the
# CLAUDE.md "Dockerfile + dotfiles_init wrapper" invariant requires
# parity with .chezmoi.toml.tmpl prompts (verify with
# `uv run --script scripts/init/dotfiles_init.py doctor`).
RUN export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && \
    ~/.local/bin/chezmoi init --apply --source=/tmp/dotfiles-source \
    --promptString "profile (ubuntu_server|ubuntu_desktop|macos|centos_server)=${CHEZMOI_PROFILE}" \
    --promptString "What is your email address=${CHEZMOI_EMAIL}" \
    --promptString "What is your full name=${CHEZMOI_NAME}" \
    --promptBool "Are you in China (behind GFW) and need to use mirrors=${CHEZMOI_USE_CHINESE_MIRROR}" \
    --promptBool "Enable gitleaks for ALL git repos (not just those with .pre-commit-config.yaml)=${CHEZMOI_GITLEAKS_ALL_REPOS}" \
    --promptBool "Install coding agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, etc.)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_CODING_AGENTS}" \
    --promptBool "Install Bitwarden CLI (and Desktop on ubuntu_desktop/macOS — snap or .deb on Linux, Cask on macOS) with SSH Agent integration=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_BITWARDEN}" \
    --promptBool "Install Python CLI tools via uv (mlflow, sqlit-tui, tmuxp, etc.)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_PYTHON_UV_TOOLS}" \
    --promptBool "Install local LLM tools (Ollama, LiteLLM, llmfit, models)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_LLM_TOOLS}" \
    --promptBool "Install AI desktop apps via macOS Homebrew Brewfile (Claude, ChatGPT, OpenCode, Antigravity, Codex, Ollama app)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_AI_DESKTOP_APPS}" \
    --promptBool "Install general GUI apps via Homebrew Brewfile (terminals, browsers, utilities, etc.; excludes AI desktop apps)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_BREW_APPS}" \
    --promptBool "Install Traditional Chinese input methods (McBopomofo, RIME)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_INPUT_METHOD}" \
    --promptChoice "Discord install channel (flatpak|deb|none)=${CHEZMOI_DISCORD_CHANNEL}" \
    --promptBool "Install networking CLI tools (nmap, mtr, httpie, gping, trippy, etc.)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_NETWORKING_TOOLS}" \
    --promptBool "Install Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Azure CLI, Terraform, OpenTofu)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_IAC_TOOLS}" \
    --promptBool "Install media/AV CLI tools (ffmpeg, ImageMagick, exiftool, libvips)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_MEDIA_TOOLS}" \
    --promptBool "No sudo/root access - skip all system package installations=${CHEZMOI_NO_ROOT}" \
    --promptChoice "Backup mode for existing dotfiles (smart|full|off)=${CHEZMOI_BACKUP_MODE}" \
    --promptBool "Allow partial Ansible failures (continue installing other tools if one role fails)=${CHEZMOI_ALLOW_PARTIAL_FAILURE}" \
    --promptChoice "SSH login banner style (figlet|fastfetch-slim|fastfetch-full)=${CHEZMOI_MOTD_STYLE}"

# Default to bash shell
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

```

```centos7
# Dotfiles test/devbox container — CentOS 7 (legacy glibc-2.17 corporate target)
# Build: docker build -f Dockerfile.centos7 -t dotfiles:centos7 .
# Run:   docker run -it dotfiles:centos7
#
# Closest reproduction of the real-world centos_server target — corporate
# data-center boxes still on CentOS Linux 7.9, often noRoot. Validates the
# user-level GitHub-release fallback paths documented in
# pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md (gate broadening: os_family in
# ["Debian", "RedHat"]) and the bootstrap's `uv tool install --python 3.13
# ansible-core` Python pin (CentOS 7 ships Python 3.6.8 system-wide).
#
# CentOS 7 EOL'd 2024-06-30. The base image's default repos point at
# mirror.centos.org which now returns 404. Redirect to vault.centos.org
# at the very top of the RUN chain — BEFORE any `yum install`.

FROM centos:7

# Build arguments for chezmoi configuration
ARG CHEZMOI_PROFILE=centos_server
ARG CHEZMOI_EMAIL=docker@example.com
ARG CHEZMOI_NAME="Docker User"
ARG CHEZMOI_USE_CHINESE_MIRROR=false
ARG CHEZMOI_GITLEAKS_ALL_REPOS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_CODING_AGENTS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_BITWARDEN=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_PYTHON_UV_TOOLS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_LLM_TOOLS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_AI_DESKTOP_APPS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_BREW_APPS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_INPUT_METHOD=false
ARG CHEZMOI_DISCORD_CHANNEL=none
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_NETWORKING_TOOLS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_IAC_TOOLS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_MEDIA_TOOLS=false
ARG CHEZMOI_NO_ROOT=false
ARG CHEZMOI_BACKUP_MODE=off
ARG CHEZMOI_ALLOW_PARTIAL_FAILURE=true
ARG CHEZMOI_MOTD_STYLE=figlet
ARG CHEZMOI_REPO=daviddwlee84

# Redirect default repos to vault.centos.org (post-EOL archive). Must run
# before the first yum invocation; otherwise mirrorlist.centos.org returns
# 404 and the layer collapses immediately.
RUN sed -i 's|^mirrorlist=|#mirrorlist=|g' /etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-*.repo \
    && sed -i 's|^#baseurl=http://mirror.centos.org|baseurl=http://vault.centos.org|g' /etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-*.repo

# Install minimal dependencies.
# python3 here is CentOS 7's 3.6.8; chezmoi bootstrap pins ansible to
# Python 3.13 via uv (auto-fetched python-build-standalone, glibc-2.17
# compatible) — see pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md and
# run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl:299-302.
RUN yum install -y \
        ca-certificates \
        curl \
        sudo \
        git \
        python3 \
    && yum clean all

# Create non-root user with sudo access
RUN useradd -m -s /bin/bash devuser \
    && echo "devuser ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" >> /etc/sudoers.d/devuser \
    && chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/devuser

# Copy local dotfiles source into image
# This allows testing local changes without pushing to GitHub
COPY --chown=devuser:devuser . /tmp/dotfiles-source

# Switch to non-root user
USER devuser
WORKDIR /home/devuser

# Install chezmoi binary
# Retry up to 3 times to handle network issues
RUN for i in 1 2 3; do \
        echo "Attempt $i: Installing chezmoi to ~/.local/bin..." && \
        sh -c "$(curl -fsLS --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 get.chezmoi.io/lb)" && \
        echo "chezmoi installed successfully" && break || \
        { echo "Attempt $i failed, retrying..."; sleep 10; }; \
    done

# Initialize and apply dotfiles with prompt values passed via flags.
# Keep this flag list IDENTICAL to Dockerfile and Dockerfile.rocky9 — the
# CLAUDE.md "Dockerfile + dotfiles_init wrapper" invariant requires
# parity with .chezmoi.toml.tmpl prompts (verify with
# `uv run --script scripts/init/dotfiles_init.py doctor`).
RUN export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && \
    ~/.local/bin/chezmoi init --apply --source=/tmp/dotfiles-source \
    --promptString "profile (ubuntu_server|ubuntu_desktop|macos|centos_server)=${CHEZMOI_PROFILE}" \
    --promptString "What is your email address=${CHEZMOI_EMAIL}" \
    --promptString "What is your full name=${CHEZMOI_NAME}" \
    --promptBool "Are you in China (behind GFW) and need to use mirrors=${CHEZMOI_USE_CHINESE_MIRROR}" \
    --promptBool "Enable gitleaks for ALL git repos (not just those with .pre-commit-config.yaml)=${CHEZMOI_GITLEAKS_ALL_REPOS}" \
    --promptBool "Install coding agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, etc.)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_CODING_AGENTS}" \
    --promptBool "Install Bitwarden CLI (and Desktop on ubuntu_desktop/macOS — snap or .deb on Linux, Cask on macOS) with SSH Agent integration=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_BITWARDEN}" \
    --promptBool "Install Python CLI tools via uv (mlflow, sqlit-tui, tmuxp, etc.)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_PYTHON_UV_TOOLS}" \
    --promptBool "Install local LLM tools (Ollama, LiteLLM, llmfit, models)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_LLM_TOOLS}" \
    --promptBool "Install AI desktop apps via macOS Homebrew Brewfile (Claude, ChatGPT, OpenCode, Antigravity, Codex, Ollama app)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_AI_DESKTOP_APPS}" \
    --promptBool "Install general GUI apps via Homebrew Brewfile (terminals, browsers, utilities, etc.; excludes AI desktop apps)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_BREW_APPS}" \
    --promptBool "Install Traditional Chinese input methods (McBopomofo, RIME)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_INPUT_METHOD}" \

337	## Testing
338	
339	Two layers, both opt-in — this is a personal dotfiles repo, tests only cover painful-regression zones:
340	
341	- **`just bats`** — fast unit tests (no Docker, no network). Covers proxy helpers (`tests/unit/zsh_proxy.bats`), `ghget` URL parsing (`tests/unit/ghget.bats`), and `lan-scan.sh` pure helpers (`tests/unit/lan_scan.bats`).
342	- **`just docker-test`** — smoke tests in a clean Ubuntu container: re-apply idempotency, zsh config parses, `oh-my-zsh` plugins present, core CLI tools on PATH, nested unit tests pass under Ubuntu zsh (`tests/smoke/docker_install.bats`).
343	- **`just check-all`** — everything: ansible syntax + pre-commit + `bats` + `docker-test`.
344	
345	`shellcheck` and `shfmt` run via pre-commit on `scripts/*.sh` (see `.pre-commit-config.yaml`).
346	
347	## Docker Testing
348	
349	```bash
350	# Build and run the bats smoke suite
351	just docker-test
352	
353	# Interactive devbox shell
354	just docker-run
355	
356	# Build specific profiles
357	just docker-desktop    # Ubuntu desktop profile
358	just docker-china      # China mirror profile
359	```
360

128	
129	## Profiles
130	
131	| Profile | OS | Tags Included |
132	|---------|-----|---------------|
133	| `macos` | macOS | homebrew, base, zsh, starship, neovim, lazyvim_deps, devtools, docker, nerdfonts, security_tools, rust_cargo_tools, ruby_gem_tools (alacritty via Brewfile cask) |
134	| `ubuntu_desktop` | Ubuntu | base, zsh, starship, neovim, lazyvim_deps, devtools, docker, nerdfonts, security_tools, rust_cargo_tools, ruby_gem_tools, gui_apps |
135	| `ubuntu_server` | Ubuntu | base, zsh, starship, neovim, lazyvim_deps, devtools, docker, security_tools, rust_cargo_tools, ruby_gem_tools |
136	| `centos_server` | CentOS 7+ / Rocky / Alma (RedHat family) | Same tag set as `ubuntu_server`. **`noRoot=true` is the expected default**: most corporate CentOS boxes lack sudo, so the user-level GitHub-release / cargo / mise fallback paths are what actually run. See [pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md) for the gate-broadening that lets those fallbacks fire on RedHat. |
137	
138	**Tag categories:**
139	
140	- **Core** (all): base, zsh, starship, neovim, lazyvim_deps, security_tools
141	- **Desktop** (macos, ubuntu_desktop): nerdfonts
142	- **macOS only**: homebrew
143	- **Optional** (via chezmoi config): coding_agents, bitwarden, python_uv_tools, js_cli_tools, llm_tools, input_method (desktop only), networking_tools, iac_tools
144	
145	`ubuntu_server` and `centos_server` exclude `nerdfonts` (no GUI needed).
146	
147	### Why `centos_server` is its own profile (and not auto-detected)
148	
149	Per [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/CLAUDE.md) the rule is *profile is for user-role choices, OS/arch facts go through `.chezmoi.os` / `.chezmoi.arch`*. CentOS-vs-Ubuntu looks like an OS fact at first glance — chezmoi exposes `.chezmoi.osRelease.id` natively, so we *could* split `ubuntu_server` behaviour by sniffing the distro. We deliberately don't:
150	
151	- Profile names are the existing UX surface — the ansible router script in `.chezmoiscripts/global/run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl` already branches on `.profile`, so adding `centos_server` keeps the divergent role behaviour discoverable in one place.
152	- Inside ansible roles, `ansible_os_family` (Debian / RedHat) does the package-manager disambiguation independently. The chezmoi profile picks **playbook + tag set**; ansible facts pick **package manager**. The two layers don't fight.
153	- The carve-out is narrow: package-manager *family* is load-bearing for which roles can run. Future RedHat-family additions (Fedora, Alma, Rocky) all reuse `centos_server` — no new profile per distro.
154	
155	## No-root mode (Linux)
156	
157	For Linux servers without sudo/root access, enable `noRoot = true` during `chezmoi init`:
158	
159	```bash
160	chezmoi init --force  # Answer "y" to "No sudo/root access" prompt
161	```
162	
163	This skips all tasks tagged with `[sudo]` (apt packages, system-level installations). Tools with user-level fallbacks are automatically installed to `~/.local/bin`.
164	
165	**User-level tools** (installed automatically without sudo):
166	
167	- **GitHub binaries**: neovim, ripgrep, fd, jq, just, bat, bats, eza, delta, yazi, superfile, zellij, btop, gitleaks, lazygit, fzf, sesh, taplo, television
168	- **tmux-appimage** (x86_64 only): extracted AppImage → `~/.local/share/tmux-appimage/squashfs-root`, shim at `~/.local/bin/tmux`. Runs only when system `tmux` is older than 3.3.
169	- **mise**: Node.js, Rust runtime management
170	- **Installers**: zoxide, starship, thefuck, tldr
171	- **cargo tools**: pueue
172	- **uv tools**: `pre-commit` (pinned to `--python 3.13`, see [docs/tools/pre-commit.md](../tools/pre-commit.md)), mlflow, sqlit-tui, tmuxp
173	- **llm tools**: ollama, litellm, llmfit, models
174	- **npm tools**: Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Bitwarden CLI
175	
176	**What you won't get without root**: zsh (needs `/etc/shells`), htop, direnv (apt only), Docker, Ollama service, system fonts, ruby + gem tools, build-essential / git / curl / wget / tree (assumed pre-installed).
177	
178	**Tip**: ask sysadmin to run `sudo apt install git curl wget zsh tmux htop direnv build-essential tree`.
179	
180	## ARM / Raspberry Pi support
181	
182	Raspberry Pi 5 (64-bit OS only) works with the `ubuntu_server` profile and gets full tool support. Raspberry Pi 4 may run 32-bit Raspberry Pi OS (armhf userland) with a 64-bit kernel (`arm_64bit=1` default), which causes `uname -m` to report `aarch64` while userland is 32-bit.
183	
184	**How it's handled:**

This is a network/TLS issue at your machine, not a Dockerfile bug. Both builds died at the very first step (pulling the base image from Docker Hub) with:

```

How does doctor check Dockerfile prompts?

```text
def doctor_scan(source_dir: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, str], set[str], dict[str, str]]:
    """Return (tmpl: {key: prompt_text}, dockerfile_keys, script: {key: prompt_text})."""
    tmpl = (source_dir / ".chezmoi.toml.tmpl").read_text()
    tmpl_pairs: dict[str, str] = {}
    for k, txt in re.findall(
        r'prompt(?:String|Bool|Choice)Once\s+\.\s+"(\w+)"\s+"([^"]+)"', tmpl):
        tmpl_pairs[k] = txt

    dockerfile = (source_dir / "Dockerfile").read_text()
    def _arg_to_camel(s: str) -> str:
        parts = s.lower().split("_")
        return parts[0] + "".join(p.title() for p in parts[1:])
    docker_args = re.findall(r"ARG\s+CHEZMOI_(\w+)\s*=", dockerfile)
    docker_keys = {_arg_to_camel(a) for a in docker_args if a.lower() != "repo"}

    script_pairs = {p.key: p.prompt_text for p in PROMPTS}
    return tmpl_pairs, docker_keys, script_pairs


def doctor_report(source_dir: Path) -> int:
    tmpl, docker, script = doctor_scan(source_dir)
    all_keys = set(tmpl) | docker | set(script)

    rows = []
    drift = False
    for k in sorted(all_keys):
        in_t = "✓" if k in tmpl else "[red]✗[/red]"
        in_d = "✓" if k in docker else "[yellow]✗[/yellow]"
        in_s = "✓" if k in script else "[red]✗[/red]"
        if not (k in tmpl and k in docker and k in script):
            drift = True
        text_note = ""
        # Prompt-text mismatches are critical — chezmoi init matches on the text.
        if k in tmpl and k in script and tmpl[k] != script[k]:
            drift = True
            text_note = f"[red]text mismatch[/red]"
        rows.append((k, in_t, in_d, in_s, text_note))

    t = Table(title="Prompt schema parity")
    t.add_column("key"); t.add_column(".chezmoi.toml.tmpl")
    t.add_column("Dockerfile"); t.add_column("dotfiles_init.py")
    t.add_column("notes")
    for row in rows:
        t.add_row(*row)
    console.print(t)

    if drift:
        console.print("[red]Drift detected — update the missing files so all three agree.[/red]")
        console.print("[dim]Prompt-text mismatches are especially important — chezmoi init\n"
                      "matches --promptBool flags by the full prompt text, not the key.[/dim]")
```
</details></tool-use>
